name: University of Glasgow
summary: A large university in the city of Glasgow, Scotland; honours degrees take four years, and degree pages give IB offers, e.g. 34 (6,5,5) for History.

ib.text: Points plus three HL grades, e.g. History 34 (6,5,5) with English HL 6 (or a humanities HL 6 and English SL 6); Economics 36 (6,6,5) with HL Maths AA. English A 5 or English B SL 6/HL 5 covers English.

apply.via: UCAS, or Common App for some subjects

UCAS deadline for international students (EU students pay international fees)

programmes.name: Veterinary Medicine & Surgery
programmes.about: Five years to qualify as a vet on the Garscube campus: body systems and disease in years 1 and 2, then clinical training, ending in a final year with no lectures, working in the school's own practices and hospitals.
programmes.ib: 38 points with 6,6,6 at HL, including Chemistry and Biology at HL. English at SL 6 and Physics or Maths at 6. Practical experience and an interview are also required.
programmes.selectionNote: Candidates considered for a place are interviewed, for overseas applicants by video between December and February. Practical experience is required.

flagshipSource.title: Veterinary Medicine: over 150 years of veterinary teaching, with accredited status from the AVMA (programme page)

programmes.name: Computing Science
programmes.about: Programming and software engineering first (Python in year 1, Java in year 2), plus algorithms, networks, AI and human-computer interaction, with other subjects in years 1 and 2 and team and individual projects at honours.
programmes.ib: 38 points with 6,6,6 at HL, including Maths AA HL 6.
programmes.selectionNote: The IB points are what is normally needed for an offer; a prediction a little below can still be considered. Exceptional grades can take a faster route.

flagshipSource.title: Computing Science: home of the School's Centre for Computing Science Education (programme page)

programmes.name: Marine & Freshwater Biology
programmes.about: The study of aquatic environments, with field courses on Loch Lomond and at Millport in the Firth of Clyde, an optional tropical marine field course in the Red Sea, and a research project in the lab or in the field.
programmes.ib: 34 points with 6,5,5 at HL, including Biology or Chemistry at HL.
programmes.selectionNote: The IB points are what is normally needed for an offer; a prediction a little below can still be considered.

flagshipSource.title: Marine & Freshwater Biology: field courses on Loch Lomond and at Millport in the Firth of Clyde (programme page)

notes: EU students pay the international fee: £28,275 a year for arts and social sciences and £33,708 for science and engineering in 2027/28.
International students can apply until 30 June, but Glasgow advises applying by the January deadline if you are unsure of your fee status.
You can apply for year 2 entry (Advanced Entry) and finish an honours degree in three years; if not accepted, you are considered for year 1.

faculties.name: College of Arts & Humanities
faculties.line: MA (Hons) degrees; each subject sets its own IB points, e.g. History 34 with English HL 6 or a humanities HL 6.

faculties.name: College of Social Sciences
faculties.line: MA (SocSci) degrees; Economics asks 36 (6,6,5) with HL Maths AA, other subjects set their own grades.

faculties.name: College of Science & Engineering
faculties.line: Maths HL for Computing Science (38 points); science degrees such as Marine Biology ask HL Biology or Chemistry.

faculties.name: College of Medical, Veterinary & Life Sciences
faculties.line: Medicine, Dentistry and Vet ask HL Chemistry and Biology plus an interview and close on 15 October; Medicine and Dentistry need UCAT.
